evidence.claim: FixedTermLoanHooks does not block the borrower from changing the market APR before the fixed term ends, so the borrower can cut the APR (to 0% or in staged 25% steps) while lenders are locked out of withdrawals, denying them yield.
evidence.support_reason: onSetAnnualInterestAndReserveRatioBips (L960-978) only forwards to MarketConstraintHooks.onSetAnnualInterestAndReserveRatioBips, which has no fixedTermEndTime check; the fixed-term gate exists only in onQueueWithdrawal (L857-859). setAnnualInterestAndReserveRatioBips (WildcatMarketConfig.sol L123-162) is onlyBorrower and applies the hook result, so the borrower can lower APR mid-term while lenders cannot queue withdrawals.
preconditions: Market deployed with FixedTermLoanHooks and a future fixedTermEndTime
Borrower (trusted role) acts to reduce APR
Lenders hold market tokens and cannot queue withdrawals until term end
